审题.题型: 情景作文：学校征求意见，大学体育设施是否应该向公众开放
任务: 开头点出话题：说明这个问题为什么受到关注，再用自己的话提出问题
亮明立场：本篇赞成开放，并加上“管理得当”这个前提
说明理由：分两条写开放的好处，每条都要有具体内容（谁需要、设施什么时候闲着）
正视可能出现的问题，给出具体的管理办法，最后回到立场
审题.语气: 正式、理性的议论语气：用 I am in favor of 亮明立场，用 First、Second 分条论证，提办法用 could，语气客观；不用口语
审题.字数: 120—180 词（题目要求 at least 120 words but no more than 180 words）；范文写到 168—180 词，本篇 171 词。两条理由加问题和办法，写到 160 词左右就开始收尾，绝不能超过 180 词
易错: 开头不要照抄题目 Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions …，要用自己的话点出话题
赞成开放也要正视问题：只写好处不写问题，文章显得片面；只写问题不给办法，立场又站不住
理由要从“谁需要”和“设施闲着”两方面写，比 It is good for people’s health 具体得多
facilities（设施）一般用复数；whether 从句作主语时谓语用单数（whether … has become）

要求.原句: As more people become health-conscious, whether university sports facilities should be open to the public has become a widely discussed question.
要求.说明: 第一句先交代背景（越来越多的人注重健康），再用 whether 从句作主语，用自己的话点出题目的问题，没有照抄题目。

要求.原句: I am in favor of opening them, provided that they are well managed.
要求.说明: in favor of 写出赞成，provided that they are well managed 加上前提，为第三段的管理办法埋下伏笔。

要求.要求: 理由一：居民需要，设施闲置
要求.原句: First, many residents, especially elderly people and children, lack convenient places to exercise, while university sports fields and courts are often empty during class hours and vacations.
要求.说明: 一边是居民缺少锻炼场所，一边是设施常常空着，用 while 一对比，开放的理由就很充分；下一句再说开放让闲置资源得到利用。

要求.要求: 理由二：拉近大学与社区
要求.原句: Second, sharing facilities brings students and local residents together and builds a closer relationship between the university and the community.
要求.说明: 第二条理由从“资源”转到“关系”：共享设施让学生和居民走到一起，大学与社区关系更密切。

要求.原句: Of course, opening the facilities may also cause problems such as overcrowding, noise and security risks.
要求.说明: 用 Of course 承认开放也有问题，并具体列出拥挤、噪音、安全隐患三项。

要求.原句: To prevent these problems, the university could require visitors to register with their ID cards, set specific opening hours and give students priority when the facilities are in high demand.
要求.说明: 三条办法对应三个问题：凭身份证登记（安全）、规定开放时间（噪音、拥挤）、需求大时学生优先，正好落实第一段的“管理得当”。

要求.原句: With careful management, opening sports facilities to the public will benefit both the university and the local community.
要求.说明: 最后一句用 With careful management 回扣第一段的前提，写出大学和社区双赢的结论。
全文共 171 词：第一段 2 句，第二段 4 句，第三段 3 句，落在 160—180 词的目标区间内，没有超过 180 词。

思路.内容: 越来越多的人注重健康，体育设施是否开放成了热门问题 → 立场：赞成开放，前提是管理得当
总起：两个主要理由 → 第一：居民（尤其老人和孩子）缺少锻炼场所，而校园场馆上课时间和假期常常空着；开放让闲置资源得到利用，鼓励更多人锻炼 → 第二：共享设施拉近学生与居民，密切大学与社区的关系

思路.作用: 正视问题，给出办法，回到立场
思路.内容: 问题：拥挤、噪音、安全隐患 → 办法：凭身份证登记、规定开放时间、需求大时学生优先 → 结论：管理细致，大学和社区都受益

步骤.标题: 背景 + 问题，用自己的话开头
步骤.做法: As more people become health-conscious 交代这个问题为什么受关注；whether … should be open to the public 作主语，has become a widely discussed question 写出它是热门话题。题目的问题就这样变成了自己的句子。
I am in favor of opening them 写出赞成，provided that they are well managed 加上前提。前提要在第三段落实，开头先埋下。
There are two main reasons for my view 一句话告诉读者下面有两条理由，阅卷老师读起来思路清楚。

步骤.标题: 理由一：需求和闲置对比，再说好处
步骤.做法: First 句用 while 把“居民缺少锻炼场所”和“校园场馆常常空着”放在一起对比；下一句用 Opening these facilities 作主语，写出两个好处：闲置资源得到利用、更多人坚持锻炼。

步骤.标题: 理由二：从资源转到关系
步骤.做法: Second 开头，用动名词 sharing facilities 作主语，brings … together 和 builds a closer relationship 两个动词写出两层好处，理由和第一条不重复。

步骤.标题: 问题 → 办法 → 结论
步骤.做法: Of course 先承认问题，such as 列出三项；To prevent these problems 引出三条办法，一一对应；最后 With careful management 回扣“管理得当”，写出双赢的结论。

句式.名称: As … whether … has become a widely discussed question 背景引题句
句式.表达: 表达“随着……，是否……已成为一个被广泛讨论的问题”，交代背景并用自己的话提出问题
句式.公式: As + 背景变化, whether + 主语 + should + 动词原形 … + has become a widely discussed question
句式.原句: As more people become health-conscious, whether university sports facilities should be open to the public has become a widely discussed question
句式.原句译: 随着越来越多的人注重健康，大学体育设施是否应该向公众开放，已成为一个被广泛讨论的问题
句式.讲解: As 在这里是“随着”，引出背景变化。health-conscious 意思是“注重健康的”，比 pay attention to health 简洁地道。whether 引导的从句作主语，谓语用单数 has become。a widely discussed question 意思是“一个被广泛讨论的问题”。

例句.en: As online learning becomes common, whether it can replace classroom teaching has become a widely discussed question.
例句.zh: 随着在线学习越来越普遍，它能否取代课堂教学已成为一个被广泛讨论的问题。

例句.en: As more students own cars, whether cars should be allowed on campus has become a widely discussed question.
例句.zh: 随着拥有汽车的学生越来越多，校园里是否应该允许开车已成为一个被广泛讨论的问题。

替换.en: With the rise of …, people are debating whether …
替换.zh: 随着……的兴起，人们在争论是否……

替换.en: Whether … has become a hot topic.
替换.zh: 是否……已成为一个热门话题。

句式.名称: in favor of … provided that 前提立场句
句式.表达: 表达“我赞成……，前提是……”，立场明确，同时加上条件
句式.公式: I am in favor of + doing …, provided that + 主语 + 谓语（条件）
句式.原句: I am in favor of opening them, provided that they are well managed
句式.原句译: 我赞成开放这些设施，前提是管理得当
句式.讲解: be in favor of 意思是“赞成”，后面接名词或动名词。provided that 意思是“前提是、只要”，比 if 更正式。them 和 they 都指上一句的 sports facilities，避免重复。

例句.en: I am in favor of taking a gap year, provided that it is well planned.
例句.zh: 我赞成休间隔年，前提是规划得当。

例句.en: I am in favor of online exams, provided that cheating can be prevented.
例句.zh: 我赞成在线考试，前提是能防止作弊。

替换.en: I am for …, on condition that …

句式.名称: A lack … while B are often empty 需求闲置对比句
句式.表达: 表达“一边是……缺少……，一边是……常常空着”，用对比说明资源应该共享
句式.公式: 人 + lack + 名词 …, while + 物 + are often empty / unused + 时间状语
句式.原句: many residents, especially elderly people and children, lack convenient places to exercise, while university sports fields and courts are often empty during class hours and vacations
句式.原句译: 许多居民，尤其是老人和孩子，缺少方便的锻炼场所，而大学的运动场和球场在上课时间和假期却常常空着
句式.讲解: while 在这里是“而、然而”，连接两个形成对比的情况：一边需要，一边闲着，开放的理由不言自明。especially elderly people and children 插在中间，指出最需要的人群，理由更具体。lack 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 of。

例句.en: Many students lack quiet places to study, while some classrooms are often empty in the evening.
例句.zh: 许多学生缺少安静的自习场所，而有些教室晚上却常常空着。

例句.en: Many children in villages lack books, while many city families keep piles of unused ones.
例句.zh: 许多乡村孩子缺少书籍，而许多城市家庭却堆着大量用不上的书。

替换.en: On the one hand, …; on the other hand, …

句式.名称: puts … to good use and encourages … 资源利用句
句式.表达: 表达“做某事能让闲置资源得到充分利用，还能鼓励更多人……”，说明一种做法的两个好处
句式.公式: 动名词主语 + puts + 资源 + to good use + and encourages + 人 + to do …
句式.原句: Opening these facilities puts idle resources to good use and encourages more people to stay active and healthy
句式.原句译: 开放这些设施能让闲置资源得到充分利用，并鼓励更多人坚持锻炼、保持健康
句式.讲解: put … to good use 意思是“充分利用”，是“充分利用资源”的地道说法（比人人都写的 make full use of the resources 更地道、更少见）。idle 意思是“闲置的”。encourage + 人 + to do 意思是“鼓励某人做……”；stay active and healthy 写出“坚持运动、保持健康”。

例句.en: Sharing used textbooks puts old books to good use and encourages students to save money.
例句.zh: 共享旧课本让旧书得到充分利用，也鼓励学生节约开支。

例句.en: Opening classrooms at night puts empty rooms to good use and encourages students to study harder.
例句.zh: 晚上开放教室让空教室得到充分利用，也鼓励学生更加努力学习。

句式.名称: Of course … may also cause problems such as 让步问题句
句式.表达: 表达“当然，做某事也可能带来一些问题，比如……”，主动承认问题
句式.公式: Of course, 动名词主语 + may also cause problems such as + 名词 A, B and C
句式.原句: Of course, opening the facilities may also cause problems such as overcrowding, noise and security risks
句式.原句译: 当然，开放设施也可能带来一些问题，比如过度拥挤、噪音和安全隐患
句式.讲解: Of course 在这里是让步，意思是“当然、诚然”，承认对方的担心。may 表示“可能”，语气有分寸。such as 后面列出三个名词，问题说得具体，下一句的办法才能对得上。

例句.en: Of course, using phones in class may also cause problems such as distraction and cheating.
例句.zh: 当然，课上使用手机也可能带来一些问题，比如分心和作弊。

例句.en: Of course, part-time jobs may also cause problems such as tiredness and lower grades.
例句.zh: 当然，兼职也可能带来一些问题，比如疲劳和成绩下降。

句式.名称: To prevent these problems, … could require 办法句
句式.表达: 表达“为了防止这些问题，某方可以要求……、规定……，并……”，针对问题给出具体办法
句式.公式: To prevent these problems, 主语 + could + require + 人 + to do …, set …, and give + 人 + priority …
句式.原句: To prevent these problems, the university could require visitors to register with their ID cards
句式.原句译: 为了防止这些问题，学校可以要求来访者凭身份证登记
句式.讲解: To prevent these problems 是目的状语，these problems 指回上一句的三个问题，衔接紧密。require + 人 + to do 意思是“要求某人做……”；register with their ID cards 意思是“凭身份证登记”。后面再接 set specific opening hours 和 give students priority，三条办法共用一个 could。

例句.en: To prevent these problems, the school could require students to hand in their phones before exams.
例句.zh: 为了防止这些问题，学校可以要求学生考前上交手机。

例句.en: To prevent accidents, the park could require cyclists to wear helmets.
例句.zh: 为了防止事故，公园可以要求骑车的人戴头盔。

替换.zh: 为了解决这些问题，……应该……

替换.en: These problems can be avoided if …
替换.zh: 如果……，这些问题就可以避免。

句式.名称: With careful management … will benefit both A and B 双赢结论句
句式.表达: 表达“只要管理细致，做某事就会让 A 和 B 都受益”，回扣前提，写出双赢的结论
句式.公式: With careful management, 动名词主语 + will benefit both + A + and + B
句式.原句: With careful management, opening sports facilities to the public will benefit both the university and the local community
句式.原句译: 只要管理细致，向公众开放体育设施将使大学和当地社区都受益
句式.讲解: With careful management 回扣第一段的 provided that they are well managed，首尾呼应。benefit 在这里是及物动词，意思是“使受益”，后面直接接宾语。both A and B 写出双赢。

例句.en: With careful planning, a part-time job will benefit both your studies and your future career.
例句.zh: 只要规划得当，兼职会对学业和未来的职业都有好处。

例句.en: With proper guidance, online learning will benefit both teachers and students.
例句.zh: 只要引导得当，在线学习会让老师和学生都受益。

替换.en: If managed well, … will be a win-win for …
替换.zh: 如果管理得当，……对……来说是双赢

替换.en: …, which will be good for both … and …

词汇.义: adj. 闲置的；未被使用的

默写.句式: As … whether … has become a widely discussed question 背景引题句
默写.意义: 交代背景、用自己的话提出问题的开头句，“是否……”类题目都能用。

默写.句式: in favor of … provided that 前提立场句
默写.意义: 赞成加前提的观点句：provided that 和图书馆一篇的 as long as 可以互换，前提要在后文用具体办法落实（本篇第 8 句）。

默写.句式: A lack … while B are often empty 需求闲置对比句
默写.意义: 用对比说明资源应该共享的高分句，开放校园设施类题目必备。

挖空: puts idle resources to good use
默写.句式: puts … to good use and encourages … 资源利用句
默写.意义: “充分利用资源”的地道说法，替代套路化的 make full use of。

默写.句式: Of course … may also cause problems such as 让步问题句
默写.意义: 主动承认问题的句子，让立场更全面。

默写.句式: To prevent these problems, … could require 办法句
默写.意义: 针对问题给出办法的模板，问题和办法一一对应。

挖空: benefit both the university and the local community
默写.句式: With careful management … will benefit both A and B 双赢结论句
默写.意义: 结尾回扣前提、写出双赢结论的高分句。

得分.说明: 题目要求就“体育设施是否应向公众开放”发表看法，范文开头用自己的话提出问题并亮明立场（赞成，前提是管理得当）；第二段分两条说明理由，第一条用“居民缺场地、校园场馆闲置”的对比，第二条写大学与社区的关系；第三段正视拥挤、噪音、安全问题，给出三条办法，最后回到前提。立场、理由、问题、办法齐全，这正是最高档（13—15 分）作文切题、思想表达清楚的样子。
引用: I am in favor of opening them, provided that they are well managed.
There are two main reasons for my view.
builds a closer relationship between the university and the community

得分.说明: 三段式：话题与立场 → 两条理由 → 问题、办法与结论。第二段先用 There are two main reasons for my view 预告，再用 First、Second 分条；Opening these facilities 指回上一句的场馆；第三段用 Of course 让步，用 To prevent these problems 承接问题给出办法，用 With careful management 呼应开头的 provided that they are well managed。前后呼应，层次分明。
引用: There are two main reasons for my view.

得分.说明: 句式多样又准确：As 引导的时间状语从句、whether 从句作主语、provided that 条件句、while 连接的对比、动名词短语作主语、such as 列举、To prevent 目的状语、both … and … 并列。用词地道，如 health-conscious、in favor of、puts idle resources to good use、stay active and healthy、give students priority、in high demand。全文没有语法错误，语言达到最高档“准确、多样”的要求。
引用: provided that they are well managed
while university sports fields and courts are often empty during class hours and vacations
puts idle resources to good use
give students priority when the facilities are in high demand
will benefit both the university and the local community

升格.原句: First, many residents, especially elderly people and children, lack convenient places to exercise, while university sports fields and courts are often empty during class hours and vacations.

步骤.写法: First, opening sports facilities is good for people’s health.
步骤.说明: 理由太笼统，谁的健康？为什么一定要用大学的设施？

步骤.写法: First, many residents have no places to exercise, but university sports fields are often empty.
步骤.说明: 有了“居民缺场地”和“设施空着”的对比，理由一下子充分了；但 have no places 说得太绝对，but 连接也比较平。

步骤.写法: First, many residents lack convenient places to exercise, while university sports fields are often empty.
步骤.说明: 用 lack convenient places 说得更准确，while 连接对比更正式。最后插入 especially elderly people and children 指出最需要的人，补上 courts 和 during class hours and vacations，事实更具体。

升格.原句: Opening these facilities puts idle resources to good use and encourages more people to stay active and healthy.

步骤.写法: We can make full use of the resources.
步骤.说明: make full use of the resources 是逐字翻译“充分利用资源”，太套路；人称也变成了 we。

步骤.写法: Opening these facilities can use the resources well and help people exercise.
步骤.说明: 用 Opening these facilities 作主语，承接上一句；写出了两个好处，但 use the resources well 平淡，help people exercise 也不够具体。

步骤.写法: Opening these facilities puts the resources to good use and encourages people to exercise.
步骤.说明: 换成地道的 put … to good use 和 encourage + 人 + to do。最后加上 idle（闲置的）呼应上一句的 empty，把 exercise 换成 stay active and healthy，“更多人”也写出来了。

升格.原句: To prevent these problems, the university could require visitors to register with their ID cards, set specific opening hours and give students priority when the facilities are in high demand.

步骤.写法: The university should make some rules.
步骤.说明: make some rules 是空话，什么规定？解决什么问题？

步骤.写法: The university could ask visitors to show their ID cards and set opening hours.
步骤.说明: 有了两条具体办法；但没有和上一句的问题连起来，也没有考虑学生。

步骤.写法: To prevent these problems, the university could require visitors to register with their ID cards and set specific opening hours.
步骤.说明: 加上 To prevent these problems 承接上文，办法和问题对上了；require … to register 比 ask … to show 更正式。最后补上 give students priority when the facilities are in high demand，照顾到学生的需要。

题目译文: 假设你们学校正在征求学生的意见（seeking students’ opinions）：大学的体育设施（university sports facilities）是否应当向社会公众开放（be open to the public）。
现在请你写一篇文章（essay），表达你的观点（express your view）。
你有 30 分钟（30 minutes）完成这项写作任务（task）。
字数：至少 120 词（at least 120 words），但不超过 180 词（no more than 180 words）。
